description: Add a new protective smart rule to the global node9 config (~/.node9/config.json). Rules can block or send dangerous commands for human review based on regex conditions. IMPORTANT: only "block" and "review" verdicts are permitted — "allow" rules are never accepted because they would weaken node9 security. Rules can only be added, never removed.

field.description: Field to inspect — "command" for bash, "sql" for database tools.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against the field.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation shown when the rule triggers.

tool.description: Tool to match — "bash", "*", or a specific tool name.

verdict.description: Action to take when the rule matches. Only "block" or "review" are allowed.

name: node9_rule_add
